title: Remove background music UI and skip the celebration page after tapping YES

requirements.text: Remove the background music section from the Landing page so no music controls are shown and no background audio element is mounted.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page no longer renders the floating music player UI.
No <audio> element for background music is mounted anywhere in the UI by default.
All other Landing page content (heading, subheading, continue button, decorations) remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Update the proposal YES button flow to skip the current heart celebration page and navigate directly to the final page after the user taps YES.

quotes: remove the heart celebration page after i tap on YESS instead land directly on last pae after i tap on YESS

acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the YES button on the proposal page does not navigate to the current celebration page route.
After tapping YES, the app navigates directly to the final page route used for the end of the experience.
The removed/skipped celebration page is not reachable via normal in-app navigation (and any route/table-of-routes is updated accordingly).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
No backend changes are required; keep the backend as-is (single Motoko actor).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new background music features or settings.
Adding new pages or changing the overall visual theme beyond what is required to remove the music section and adjust YES navigation.
